idea-plugin.name: Image Host Transfer Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Names every image, font, badge and embed in your docs that sends an EU reader's IP outside the EEA - and the fix for each one.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Image Host Transfer Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 17 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/image-host-transfer-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/image-host-transfer-lint

action.text: Image Host Transfer Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Image Host Transfer Lint on the file in the editor
